description: Use this when the user asks which moments to clip or what a campaign's videos are: the analyzed source videos of a campaign and the moments worth clipping in each. Per source the video details we store: title, the channel it came from, publish date, length, view count, language, speaker count, chapters with their times, format (shape and on-screen text lines), readiness (how clip-ready it is), Clip Potential (0 to 100) and a short summary in our own words. A brand file is named by its number, never by its file name, and has no link. Per moment the start and end, what happens there in our own words, its score, whether it opens on a spoken line, its 9:16 fit and a Watch link that opens the original public video at that second. Every moment of the Moment Map, signed in or not, with brand risk moments flagged. Never a transcript or a transcript line. Signed in, ClippingAlpha's server can cut a moment of a public video or of a public brief's brand file into a vertical MP4 with captions. Read only.

campaign.description: The campaign as brand/series (for example lovable/clipping), its clippingalpha.com page URL, or its numeric campaignId from another tool.

source_id.description: Only this source, by the sourceId of an earlier answer.
